title: Graphs on Topological Spaces
summary: Graphs defined on groups, such as power graphs, enhanced power graphs and commuting graphs, form a hierarchy under inclusion of edge sets. We develop an analogous theory for topological spaces. To a space X we attach five graphs on the vertex set X, all invariant under homeomorphisms: the specialization, inseparability, closure-meeting, Urysohn and functional graphs. They form a diamond-shaped hierarchy whose members are null exactly when X is T_1, Hausdorff, Urysohn or functionally Hausdorff.
